title: Serum Potassium Trending
scenario: A 72-year-old client admitted with heart failure is receiving IV furosemide twice daily. Serial serum potassium levels are drawn over 48 hours.

tabs.title: Serum Potassium Trend
rows: New premature ventricular contractions on monitor.

questions.subject: Medical-Surgical
questions.stem: Based on the potassium trend, which pattern is the nurse observing?
questions.rationale: The potassium falls from 4.2 to 2.9 mEq/L over 48 hours of loop diuretic therapy, a progressive hypokalemia now below the normal range.

questions.subject: Medical-Surgical
questions.stem: Given the trend, which actions should the nurse anticipate or take? Select all that apply.

options.text: Notify the provider of the falling potassium and new PVCs
Anticipate an order for potassium replacement
Administer an additional dose of furosemide now

questions.rationale: Worsening hypokalemia with new ectopy warrants provider notification, anticipated replacement, and continued monitoring. Giving more diuretic or restricting potassium would worsen the imbalance.
